import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import norm
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def task_func(length):
    MU = 0
    SIGMA = 1

    data = np.random.normal(loc=MU, scale=SIGMA, size=length)

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()

    if length > 0:
        ax.hist(data, bins="auto", density=True, alpha=0.6, color="steelblue", edgecolor="black")
        x_min = min(np.min(data), MU - 4 * SIGMA)
        x_max = max(np.max(data), MU + 4 * SIGMA)
    else:
        x_min, x_max = MU - 4 * SIGMA, MU + 4 * SIGMA

    x = np.linspace(x_min, x_max, 300)
    pdf = norm.pdf(x, loc=MU, scale=SIGMA)
    ax.plot(x, pdf, color="crimson", linewidth=2)

    ax.set_xlabel("Value")
    ax.set_ylabel("Density")
    ax.set_title("Normal Distribution Histogram and PDF")

    return data, ax
